description: Header file defining the NetworkManagerClient class, which provides an interface for managing network connections, WiFi, and WPS functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin for Raspberry Pi 4. It includes method declarations for network interface management, WiFi operations, and WPS processing.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: A singleton class providing network management functionalities such as interface configuration, WiFi operations, and WPS control within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkManagerClient.

methods.name: getAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: setPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Sets the specified interface as the primary network interface.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified network interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for a given interface.

methods.name: getPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the current primary network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface.

methods.name: getInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if a specific interface is enabled.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Gets IP configuration for a specified interface and IP version.

methods.name: getKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Lists known WiFi SSIDs.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves information about the currently connected WiFi SSID.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a WiFi SSID to the known list.

methods.name: removeKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Removes a WiFi SSID from the known list.

methods.name: startWifiScan
methods.description: Initiates a WiFi scan, optionally for a specific SSID.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if WiFi scan was performed within a recent time limit.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information for a specified interface.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a WiFi network with provided connection info.

methods.name: wifiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current WiFi network.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a known WiFi connection by interface and ID.

methods.name: getWifiState
methods.description: Retrieves the current WiFi state.

methods.name: getWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Gets signal quality metrics for a WiFi network.

methods.name: startWPS
methods.description: Starts the WPS process.

methods.name: stopWPS
methods.description: Stops the WPS process.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Sets the device hostname.

methods.name: modifyDefaultConnectionsConfig
methods.description: Modifies default connection configurations.

methods.name: wpsProcess
methods.description: Internal method to handle WPS process logic.

methods.name: getMatchingSSIDInfo
methods.description: Finds matching SSID info and access point path.

methods.name: isActiveApSameAsWps
methods.description: Checks if active AP matches WPS SSID.
